description: RIU.ai is an AI-driven ESG and carbon accounting platform that automates sustainability data, streamlines compliance, scales decarbonization, and accelerates strategic decision-making. The platform centralizes scattered ESG data into a single source of truth, provides analytics, benchmarking, and reduction insights, and automates reporting. Features include real-time ESG analytics, audit-ready carbon accounting, built-in AI chatbot (RIU Sense), and supplier risk intelligence. Supports global frameworks: BRSR, GRI, SASB, TCFD, CSRD, ISSB, GHG Protocol, UN SDGs, ISO 14064, CDP, and SBTi-aligned net-zero targets. Trusted by industry leaders including Kennametal and Time Technoplast.
